title: Unit 9 Talking time
description: 机器对齐待审听；以下原稿句暂未可靠定位，不参与同步（完整原稿保留）：第7句「Besides, it was 30 tons.」；第12句「What makes this happen?」；第16句「How small can a computer be now?」；第17句「In 2018, scientists made super small computers.」；第18句「They were as small as a grain of salt.」；第22句「My classmates and I can send emails, search for information and do our homework better.」
